name: Iron Sanguine Knight's Skinpack
summary: These are knights of iron and flame. It seems like every visor hides an oath that never died ...
legend: Long before the first torch was lit, the Iron Sanguine Order sealed its oath in a hall of glowing stone. Each knight swore on a different metal, and each metal answered with a light of its own. The Purple Epic Knight still walks the deep roads, cyan light burning through his visor like a cold star. Somewhere beyond the Nether gate, the Fire Knight leaves footprints of living flame, his red eyes never blinking. And in the frozen ruins, the Knight Magic guards a secret that makes the air around his gauntlets shimmer turquoise. Travellers say the Order disbanded centuries ago. Yet every so often, a new banner appears on the castle walls, and a new pair of eyes lights up in the dark. The question isn't whether more knights will come. It's what they swore to protect.

skins.name: Purple Epic Knight
skins.story: The Order's first champion, clad in deep purple plate, his cyan visor and chest diamond glowing like a captured star.

skins.name: Green Knight
skins.story: A forest warden in emerald armour, gold banding his visor, chest and greaves, sworn to guard the wild roads.

skins.name: Golden Lord
skins.story: Ruler of the Order in gleaming gold plate, a crimson gem on his chest and red bands marking his royal blood.

skins.name: Yellow Knight
skins.story: The Golden Lord's sworn twin, his yellow armour streaked with ember-orange, forged in the same furnace but cooled by fire.

skins.name: Blue Knight
skins.story: A loyal sky-blue sentinel with a golden crest and belt, who keeps watch from the castle walls at dawn.

versions.note: The Order's first banners are raised: five knights in purple, green, gold, yellow and blue answer the oath.

skins.name: Knight Magic
skins.story: A crowned steel sorcerer whose cyan eyes and turquoise flame-runes crawl across his gauntlets and legs whenever magic stirs.

skins.name: Knight Gold
skins.story: A masked king in a golden crown and blood-red cape, his grey plate bearing the Order's ancient sigil.

skins.name: Fire Knight
skins.story: Born beyond the Nether gate, his red eyes never blink and orange flames burn eternally on his hands and feet.

versions.note: Three darker sworn knights step out of the shadows: a crowned king, a cyan-runed sorcerer and a knight wreathed in fire.

skins.name: Silver Paladin
skins.story: A holy warrior in polished silver, a golden cross shining on his blue tabard, gold trimming every plate.

skins.name: Netherite Knight
skins.story: Forged from black netherite and gold, his orange eyes smoulder behind the visor like coals that never cool.

skins.name: Copper Knight
skins.story: An ancient copper guardian, his orange plate slowly eaten by teal patina, still marching after centuries of rain.

skins.name: Bone Knight
skins.story: A fallen knight returned as bone, green eyes glowing in his skull, his ribcage wrapped in rotting dark-green armour.

versions.note: The forges reignite as silver, netherite, copper and even bone join the ranks, each one a different metal sworn to the old oath.

versions.title: Order of the Frost

skins.name: Frost Warden
skins.story: He guards the pass where winter never ends, his ice-blue plate cold enough to freeze the blade that strikes it.

skins.name: Rime Lancer
skins.story: An old knight with a frost-white beard who has ridden into every blizzard since the order was founded.

versions.note: From the frozen north ride two knights of the Frost Order: a warden in ice-blue plate and a lancer whose beard is white with rime.

versions.title: The Emerald Vow

skins.name: Jade Sentinel
skins.story: Keeper of the emerald gate, he wears the golden lion of his house and has never once stepped back.

skins.name: Thorn Knight
skins.story: His tabard carries a black thorn on dark green, a warning to anyone who thinks the forest is undefended.

skins.name: Rose Paladin
skins.story: She rides into battle with roses woven into her armour, and every knight she saves gets one to keep.

versions.note: Three knights swear the Emerald Vow: a sentinel with a golden lion, a thorn knight over chainmail and a paladin of roses.

versions.title: Night Watch

skins.name: Obsidian Guard
skins.story: Forged from volcanic glass, he only opens his violet eyes when an enemy reaches the castle walls.

skins.name: Sun Herald
skins.story: His white-gold armour catches the last light of the day and keeps it burning on his chest all night long.

skins.name: Storm Knight
skins.story: Lightning chose him on the battlefield, and the yellow bolt on his dark-blue plate has never stopped crackling.

versions.note: When the sun goes down, the Night Watch takes the walls: an obsidian guard with horns, a herald of the sun and a knight who carries the storm.

logoPrompt: Square logo, a single blocky Minecraft-style knight in red and charcoal-grey armour, glowing red eyes in a dark helmet, small orange glowing eyes on the chest plate, his hands and feet engulfed in bright orange-yellow pixel flames, dramatic fiery glow and rising embers, pitch-black background, low camera angle, no text.
coverPrompt: Wide cinematic cover, three blocky Minecraft-style knights side by side: on the left a purple-armoured knight with a glowing cyan visor, cyan chest diamond and cyan bands at waist and shins; in the centre a dark steel knight with a spiked crown helm, glowing cyan eyes and cyan flame patterns on his hands and legs; on the right a red and charcoal knight with glowing red eyes and orange-yellow flames on hands and feet. Background: a ruined castle hall at night, torchlight and drifting embers, moody mist. Above them the title "Knights Collection" in big stylised metallic medieval letters.
